request: Two ads have been running side by side in our Criminal Defense ad group. Over the last 90 days, did one of them really win? Then design the next test for that ad group.

account.account: A US criminal and traffic defense law firm

defaults_used.primary_metric: click-through rate (too few conversions to test conversion rate, see sizing)
defaults_used.mde: smallest relative lift that fits in 8 weeks

data_pulled.used_for: message gap for the next hypothesis

note: Real run on 2026-10-06 on a client Google Ads account through the InsightfulPipe CLI, anonymised: firm name, state, website, ids and the numbers in ad claims are replaced ([Firm], [State], [N]); campaign names are generic; money is rounded to the nearest $10, cost per click to the nearest 10 cents and cost per conversion to whole dollars. Impressions, clicks and conversions are as returned.
